name: valora-plugin-obsidian
description: Bridges the Valora memory vault to Obsidian — sets up vault config and opens it.

cli.name: obsidian open
cli.description: Sync Obsidian config and open the Valora memory vault in Obsidian

requiresBinary.installCommand: OS=$(uname -s 2>/dev/null); ARCH=$(uname -m 2>/dev/null); if [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then brew install --cask obsidian; elif [ "$OS" = "Linux" ]; then curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases/releases/latest -o /tmp/obsidian-release.json; if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ] || [ "$ARCH" = "arm64" ]; then URL=$(python3 -c "import json; assets=json.load(open('/tmp/obsidian-release.json'))['assets']; urls=[a['browser_download_url'] for a in assets if a['name'].endswith('arm64.AppImage')]; print(urls[0] if urls else '')"); [ -n "$URL" ] && curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /tmp/obsidian.AppImage && chmod +x /tmp/obsidian.AppImage && sudo mv /tmp/obsidian.AppImage /usr/local/bin/obsidian; else URL=$(python3 -c "import json; assets=json.load(open('/tmp/obsidian-release.json'))['assets']; urls=[a['browser_download_url'] for a in assets if a['name'].endswith('amd64.deb')]; print(urls[0] if urls else '')"); [ -n "$URL" ] && curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /tmp/obsidian.deb && sudo dpkg -i /tmp/obsidian.deb; fi; fi
requiresBinary.name: obsidian
